title: docs(adr,skills): ADR-0144 Open items 11 and 12 settled and Open item 13 for the record-mode switch; skills name the backfill and the grouped-only aggregate (multi-currency, epic #8345)
body:
epic:#8345#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbTZrFqRYNgjSaSbN5

Part of #8345 (no card of its own: the epic PM carries these governed lines, as cards #27577, #27579 and #27185 and the PR #27475 review record route them here).
PR #28128 (the command the field-types line names; Open item 13 cites it) merged as `a3d24c99`; this branch carries that merge.
Ruling-ref: 6522614678

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** ADR-0144 开放项 11（`sys_exchange_rate` 归属 platform-objects，PR #27246）与 12（fixed↔fixed 两种形状编译期拒绝，裁决 6486427200，PR #27991）各加一条日期注记标为已定；新增开放项 13：已有数据的金额字段切到 `record`（裁决 6492000994 B，PR #28128 的回填命令与 409），并记下多组织部署上单一 `--code` 可能写错、与云租户入口一起留待以后；skills 两行：field-types 点名 `os migrate record-currency-codes`，dashboards 把「ungrouped」改成「unless grouped by its code field」。
- **为什么改：** ADR 每次有答复就要修订；skills 原样发给第三方 AI 作者，要与已落地的行为一致。
- **风险与回滚：** 纯文字，不动代码与 schema；两个 skills 文件都在 token 上限内（field-types 3207/3207，dashboards 6261/6262），靠删同文件里的重复句付费。回滚即撤 PR。
- **先看：** ADR-0144「Open items」11–13，再看两个 skills 文件的 diff（各 3–6 行）。
- **两分钟验证：** `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`、`pnpm check:adr-anchors`、`pnpm check:adr-index` 均退出 0。
- **需要你做的：** Tier H（`docs/adr/**`、`skills/**`）：契约复审 PASS 与席位 ACCEPT 之后，由 `os-zhuang` 或 `hotlong` 在该 head 批准；#28128 已合并（`a3d24c99`）。

## What changes

**`docs/adr/0144-…`, Open items** (this record is amended with each answer, as its own Open items preamble says):
- **Item 11** gets a `*Note (2026-10-30):*` marking it settled. `@objectstack/platform-objects` owns `sys_exchange_rate`, landed in PR #27246 (`194e66c0`). The reasoning is the settlement's own, from 6511509227 on #27185: the one reader is the engine's write path; ADR-0029 D2 gives it no capability boundary; it registers with `sys_migration` and `sys_secret`.
- **Item 12** gets a settled note. Ruling 6486427200 on #8345, letter A, refuses both `fixed`-vs-`fixed` shapes at dataset compile, and card #27579 landed that in PR #27991 (`6dc06b2e`). What #27991 refuses, and what it leaves unjudged, is read off `measure-currency-coherence.ts` at that commit.
- **New item 13** covers switching an amount with stored rows to `currencyMode: 'record'`. It is written as the open question, which PR #27339's review 6490309706 ③ escalated, followed by the settled note: ruling 6492000994, letter B. PR #28128 (`a3d24c99`) landed that ruling with the backfill command and the 409 `currency_mode_to_record` finding, lifted by `force`, which reads no row and is not refused at boot. Two things stay open: how a cloud tenant without a CLI reaches the backfill (left open by the ruling), and, beside it, the fact that one `--code` is written across every organization's rows. The second is should-fix S1 of PR #28128's contract review.

**`skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md`** adds one line: an amount field with stored rows that is switched to `'record'` is backfilled with `os migrate record-currency-codes`. It is paid for by deleting the derived-measure sentence, which restates `objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md`; a pointer to that guide replaces it. The ratchet reads 3207 / 3207.

**`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md`**: "refuses `currency` and ungrouped sum/avg/min/max" becomes "refuses `currency`, and sum/avg/min/max unless grouped by its code field". This is the should-fix from PR #27475's review (6499106478), which its seat record (6499122847) carried here. It is paid for by dropping a restated key (`e.g. currency: 'USD'` → `e.g. 'USD'`). The ratchet reads 6261 / 6262.

**`.changeset/8345-currency-mode-switch-skills.md`**: `@objectstack/skills` patch, the same shape as #27475's skills changeset.

## Why

The ADR says it is "amended with each answer". Open items 11 and 12 have been answered and have landed, and the mode switch was ruled after the ADR merged. The skills catalog ships verbatim to third-party agents, so it has to name the backfill and describe the grouped-only aggregate rule that the engine enforces. Ruling 6522614678 (letter A) puts this PR on the R2 development path; it is not release-paired.

## Verification

Head: the docs commit, a merge of `main` after #28128 landed, and the item 13 citation of `a3d24c99`. The text was drafted by the seat, and the final pass was made at the derived mandated tier, which was checked against `git show 194e66c0`, `git show 6dc06b2e` and PR #28128's diff.

- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: exit 0 (field-types 3207 / 3207, dashboards 6261 / 6262).
- `pnpm check:adr-anchors`, `pnpm check:adr-index`, `pnpm check:adr-symbol-anchors` and `node scripts/check-adr-links.mjs`: exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` on `23b3eb6c` (4 paths against `origin/main`) derives 49 families. Each was run with its exit code captured before any pipe, and all 49 exited 0. The dist-reading families ran after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build`. That build had 114 of 115 tasks green. The one red was `@object-ui/console`, which read a `@object-ui/react` dist built before `main` was merged in mid-build. It is unrelated to this markdown-only diff.
- The derived model tier for `docs/adr/**` and `skills/**` is the mandated tier at xhigh. The final text pass ran there.
